name: Shenzhen Xunjiexing Technology Corp. Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Xunjiexing Technology Corp. Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of printed circuit boards (PCB) in China. It offers PCB samples and batch boards, and raw materials. It serves automotive electronics, computer communications, smart consumer devices, smart security, industrial control, medical equipment, new energy, and rail transit industries. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, the People's Republic of China.
